thread:
Alisha: Heads upwe had a 95th+ latency spike on 2025-12-01 03:12 UTC. I want a small set of panels to trace batching behavior quickly.
Mateo: Ok. Which signals are must-haves?
Alisha: KV cache hit rate (global + per-model_family), batch tokens_in vs batch_capacity to compute utilization, kernel_variant counts by model_family (5m), queue depth by priority. Also show token_budget_target overlay.
Ryan: Add tokens_in vs tokens_out per second so we can spot sources/sinks. Also annotate deploys.
Jane: For the kernel counts, let's avoid high cardinality labels. Use kernel_variant and model_family only. Keep device and request_id out.
sre-bot: Alert (2025-12-01T03:14:00Z): elevated tail latency on cluster-east correlated with kv_cache_hit_rate drop.
Alisha: Good. I sketched a few PromQL snippets:
```
# KV hit rate by model_family (5m)
(sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total[5m])) by (model_family) / sum(rate(kv_cache_lookups_total[5m])) by (model_family)) * 100

# Kernel selection counts (5m)
sum(increase(kernel_selection_total[5m])) by (kernel_variant, model_family)

# Effective batch utilization (1m window)
(sum(rate(batch_tokens_in[1m])) by (queue) / avg_over_time(config_max_tokens_per_batch[1m])) * 100

# Tokens ingress/egress per second
sum(rate(tokens_ingested_total[1m])) by (cluster)
sum(rate(tokens_emitted_total[1m])) by (cluster)
```
Mateo: We don't currently expose config_max_tokens_per_batch as a metric. I can add that gauge from the runtime. Will keep it low-cardinality (label by queue only).
Ryan: Kernel selection should be sampled to limit metrics volume. Propose emitting kernel_selection_total at 0.5% for high-traffic paths; full sampling for kv cache hits/lookups remains.
Jane: Dashboard idea:
- Top-left: KV hit rate timeseries (stacked by model_family) w/ deploy annotations
- Top-right: Kernel variant stacked bar (3h window) by model_family
- Mid: Queue depth heatmap split by priority class
- Bottom: Tokens/sec + token_budget_target overlay + utilization gauge
Alisha: Also add a small table showing kernel_selector_failures_total and a sparkline for compile_reason=cold_start so we catch compilation spikes.
Mateo: One note: kernel_selection_total is emitted after the compile decision, so cold_start spikes will show up. We'll add a label compile_reason=cold_start or compile_reason=warm. That'll help triage.
Ryan: I'll add a sampled tracing span batcher.kernel_choice with attributes {model_family, kernel_variant, queue, batch_size, kv_hit} at 0.2% sampling so we can join traces to logs for interesting events.
Jane: For alerts I propose:
- KV_CACHE_HIT_LOW: global kv_cache_hit_rate < 65% for 10m
- BATCH_UTIL_LOW: avg(batch_utilization) < 20% for 15m AND tokens_in_queue > 400
- KERNEL_COMPILE_SPIKE: increase(kernel_selector_failures_total[10m]) > 5
Alisha: Sounds reasonable. Who owns what?
Mateo: I'll implement the config_max_tokens_per_batch gauge and add sampled kernel metrics. Planning a lightweight sampling decorator in the selector path. PR by EOD PT.
Ryan: I'll wire up tracing and add the span. Also add tokens_ingested/emitted counters to the collector if missing. PR by tomorrow morning.
Jane: I'll prototype Grafana panels and alert rules, then post dashboard JSON to #eng-runtime. ETA: noon PT tomorrow.
Alisha: I'll wire the panels into our dashboards and create an umbrella issue linking PRs and owners. I'll include runbook notes for the KV cache alert.
ops-bot: Note: Dedicated capacity rollouts on 2025-12-03 may change traffic patterns. Mark as timeline annotation.
Mateo: Quick implementation detail: kernel_selection_total should not have per-host labels. We'll emit host info to a separate low-volume debug metric only when debug flag is enabled.
Ryan: For correlation queries, example to compare kernel churn to kv misses:
```
# kernel churn vs kv lookup misses (5m)
sum(increase(kernel_selection_total[5m])) by (kernel_variant) / sum(rate(kv_cache_lookups_total[5m]))
```
Jane: Once we have the panels up, let's run a 24h monitoring sweep to baseline metrics. If KV hit drops again, we can use traces to pinpoint which model_family and queues were impacted.
Alisha: Thanks everyone. Opening the issue now and tagging the owners. We'll reconvene after the dashboard is live or if the SRE alert repeats. :thumbsup:
